name: Age of War 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Age of Wars 2 is a strategy war game set in the age of the cavemen. Start as mere cavemen, and then advance your way through the ages in an epic struggle to defeat your opponent in Age of War 2, the sequel to the successful strategy/defense game. While the goal may be simple—destroy the enemy base—you have to prevent yours from being destroyed, too. To do this, you’ll need to spawn units from the selection in the top right. You’ll earn gold and experience as you go, and you can upgrade your units, build defensive turrets, activate special abilities, and of course, advance your age.
